notes: Get a Compass card for the SkyTrain, buses and SeaBus (North Vancouver). The Canada Line to YVR takes 25 minutes (extra 5 CAD). Free shuttles to Capilano and Grouse leave from Canada Place.
Summer is dry and 22-26°C, with daylight until 21:30. The Celebration of Light fireworks (July-August), Whistler summit hikes and the beaches make this the best season.
Tax (12%) is not included in prices, and tipping is 18%. Capilano is expensive at 75 CAD (Lynn is free), Grouse is 80 and the Whistler bus is 50-70.
Try salmon, sushi (Miku aburi), Japadog and spot prawns (May); have breakfast at Granville Market.
Book your Whistler bus with Skylynx days ahead. Peak 2 Peak is cheaper on summer weekdays; combine it with the Sea to Sky Gondola.
Apply for the Canada eTA online. Vancouver is safe; just pass through the Downtown Eastside (Hastings) without stopping.

stops.name: Stanley Park Seawall Bisiklet
stops.tips: Rent a bike from Denny's/Spokes (15 CAD for 2 hours). Ride the 9 km seawall, passing under Lions Gate Bridge to Third Beach.

stops.name: Stanley Park Totem Poles
stops.tips: The totem poles at Brockton Point; First Nations heritage.

stops.name: Vancouver Aquarium
stops.tips: Inside the park; sea otters and the Amazon gallery.

stops.name: Prospect Point Cafe
stops.tips: Park cafe with views of the bridge.

stops.name: Coal Harbour Seawall & Canada Place
stops.tips: The terminal with its sail-shaped roofs. Try FlyOver Canada (35 CAD) and watch seaplanes take off and land.

backups.name: Vancouver Lookout Harbour Centre
backups.tips: Observation tower; an alternative to the aquarium.

stops.name: Granville Island Public Market
stops.tips: An arts island under the bridge. Try Lee's Donuts and the salmon, and take the Aquabus ferry (5 CAD) to get there.

stops.name: Granville Island Sanatçı Atölyeleri
stops.tips: Glass, ceramics and the Net Loft; Kids Market.

stops.name: Kitsilano Beach
stops.tips: Kits Beach and its saltwater pool (137 m, summer only), with mountain views.

stops.name: Sophie's Cosmic Cafe Kitsilano
stops.tips: Retro brunch on 4th Avenue.

stops.name: Museum of Anthropology UBC
stops.tips: Bill Reid's Raven sculpture and totem poles, in a glass building on the UBC campus.

backups.name: Vanier Park & Museum of Vancouver
backups.tips: Space centre and city museum; close to MOA, so a good alternative.

backups.name: Go Fish Granville
backups.tips: Fish taco shack on the pier.

stops.name: Capilano Suspension Bridge Park
stops.tips: A 137 m suspension bridge, plus Treetops and Cliffwalk. Take the free shuttle from Canada Place; it is quiet at 09:00. In winter, see the Canyon Lights.

stops.name: Grouse Mountain Skyride
stops.tips: Ride the gondola up to 1,100 m. Watch the lumberjack show, see the grizzly bears, or tackle the Grouse Grind (a steep 2.9 km hike, free to climb).

stops.name: Grouse Mountain Altitudes Bistro
stops.tips: Lunch at the summit with views over the city.

stops.name: Lynn Canyon Park
stops.tips: Free suspension bridge and the 30 Foot Pool; Capilano's free sibling.

backups.name: Lonsdale Quay Market
backups.tips: Market by the SeaBus terminal in North Vancouver.

backups.name: Deep Cove
backups.tips: Canoe rental and the Quarry Rock hike; try the Honey Doughnuts. A good alternative to Lynn.

stops.name: Sea to Sky Highway Shannon Falls
stops.tips: Take the bus (Skylynx/YVR), about 2 hours. On the way, stop at the 335 m waterfall and see the Stawamus Chief.

stops.name: Sea to Sky Gondola Squamish
stops.tips: Gondola up to 885 m, with a suspension bridge and fjord views.

stops.name: Whistler Village
stops.tips: The pedestrian Olympic village, with the rings and shops.

stops.name: Peak 2 Peak Gondola
stops.tips: The record-breaking gondola (3 km) between Whistler and Blackcomb. Enjoy summit hikes and glacier views in summer, skiing in winter.

stops.name: Purebread Whistler
stops.tips: A legendary bakery; try the scones and cakes, then catch the return bus.

backups.name: Brandywine Falls
backups.tips: A 70 m waterfall; free, so a good alternative to the gondola.

stops.name: Gastown Steam Clock
stops.tips: The steam clock whistles every 15 minutes. Visit Gassy Jack Square and its cobblestones.

stops.name: Dr. Sun Yat-Sen Classical Chinese Garden
stops.tips: The first Ming-style garden outside China; the neighbouring park is free.

stops.name: Phnom Penh
stops.tips: Cambodian-Vietnamese food; try the chicken wings and beef luc lac. Expect a queue.

stops.name: Yaletown
stops.tips: A former warehouse district. See the Roundhouse locomotive, David Lam Park and the False Creek seawall.

stops.name: Japadog Robson
stops.tips: Japanese-style hot dogs (terimayo); on Robson Street.

backups.name: Vancouver Art Gallery
backups.tips: The Emily Carr collection; an alternative to the police museum.

stops.name: Queen Elizabeth Park
stops.tips: The city's highest point, with quarry gardens, the skyline and the Bloedel Conservatory (8 CAD).

stops.name: VanDusen Botanical Garden
stops.tips: Summer flowers and a maze.

stops.name: Main Street Vintage
stops.tips: Vintage and design shops in Mount Pleasant, plus murals (August festival).

stops.name: Commercial Drive
stops.tips: Little Italy: coffee at Cafe Calabria, Havana, and sandwiches at La Grotta del Formaggio.

stops.name: Trout Lake Park
stops.tips: A neighbourhood lake; farmers' market on Saturdays.

backups.name: Vij's Restaurant
backups.tips: Canada's famous Indian restaurant on Cambie. No reservations, so expect a queue.

backups.name: Science World
backups.tips: Science museum in a geodesic dome by False Creek; an alternative to the garden (with kids).

stops.name: English Bay Beach
stops.tips: A-maze-ing Laughter sculptures and the Inukshuk; a good morning walk.

stops.name: Davie Village
stops.tips: Rainbow crosswalks and cafes in the West End.

stops.name: Medina Cafe
stops.tips: The city's most famous brunch; waffles and tagine. Expect a queue.

stops.name: Waterfront Canada Line YVR
stops.tips: The Canada Line reaches the airport in 25 minutes. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Roedde House Museum
backups.tips: A Victorian house in the West End; an alternative to Davie.
